name: search_artists
description: Search for music artists by name. Returns artist IDs, names, types, and countries. Use get_artist to fetch full discography and biographical details.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

name: get_artist
description: Get artist details including biography, country, founding date, and complete release list. Requires artist ID from search_artists.

name: search_releases
description: Search for albums and releases by title or artist name. Returns release IDs, titles, artists, release dates, and formats.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

name: get_release
description: Get release details: full track listing, credits, media formats, and metadata. Requires release ID from search_releases.
